description_en: Adds multiple databases to a network domain at a time
description_zh: 批量将数据库移入指定网络域
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost move-databases-to-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zpr3h2zo60l --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 3 --database-ids 1,2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveDatabasesToNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to which you want to add databases.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to query the network domain ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移入的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the databases that you want to add to the network domain
parameters.help_zh: 指定要移入网络域的数据库实例ID
parameters.name: database_ids

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Code.description_en:
Indicates whether the database is added to the network domain.

The code LICENSE_OUT_OF_LIMIT indicates that the network domain feature is not supported by the current Bastionhost edition
Code.description_zh:
接口调用的结果。

LICENSE_OUT_OF_LIMIT 表示当前版本许可没有开启网络域功能

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned
